name: hand-line-boil
title: Line Boil
description: Hình vẽ được vẽ lại 12 lần mỗi giây, mỗi lần lệch một chút nên nét run rẩy như phim vẽ tay.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lp-boil, written here): Redraw at 12 fps (2 frames per drawing at 24 fps, ~83 ms), cycling 3 variants, each jittering the drawing +-1.5 px. Demo: a face circle r 50 from 41 points, radius jitter +-2 px re-seeded every 1/12 s (no fixed variants), eyes +-1 px. Params: fps (12) · amp (±1.5 px) · variants (3). An SVG displacement filter whose noise seed changes 12 times a second, cycling a few variants, so any drawing or text boils like hand animation.
